title: An Exact Five-Dimensional Counterexample to Concavity of Determinantal-Process Entropy
statement_scope: The original Lyons Conjecture 2.6 is false for finite-dimensional complex Hilbert spaces: explicit strict positive contractions K-hA and K+hA on five labelled coordinates have midpoint K and satisfy H(K)<(H(K-hA)+H(K+hA))/2.
